chunks: The hypocrites will be in the lowest depths of Hell, and you will find none to help them.

key_terms.الدَّرْكِ الْأَسْفَلِ: The lowest depth, referring to the deepest part of Hell
key_terms.الْمُنَافِقِينَ: The hypocrites, those who outwardly profess faith but conceal disbelief
key_terms.نَصِيرًا: A helper or one who provides support

ai.seo_question: Where are the hypocrites located in the afterlife according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (4:145) underscores the ultimate spiritual bankruptcy of the hypocrites, whose outward piety masks an inner void that renders them distinct from even the general disbelievers. The phrase 'no helper for them' highlights the futility of worldly alliances or intercessors on the Day of Judgment, reinforcing the concept of divine justice where each soul bears its own burden. This placement in the 'lowest depth' signifies a permanent state of deprivation from God's mercy, a key theme in understanding the hierarchy of the afterlife in Islamic theology.
